end.1: You know, after everything that happened, I thought it was time to retire... For years I've wandered these lands with no results, and in the end, I even failed in my one true goal.
end.2: So I thought about it, and I came to a conclusion... No, my journey isn't over yet, there's still something I can do.
end.3: Now that you've found the cure, someone needs to spread it, right? I'll do it. I'll travel to faraway places and bring it to anyone who needs it. That will be my redemption.
end.4: But don't be sad about my departure, colleague! Sooner or later, our paths will cross again. I'm sure of it.
end.5: Anyway, I wanted to thank you once more. If it weren't for you, I wouldn't be here, standing, breathing, and above all, there wouldn't be hope for a new world. For all this, thank you.
